description: Row of partner logos, customer logos, or integration chips. 'chips' variant renders as text chips with primary-color dot (no image needed — good for integrations / capabilities). 'logos' variant renders actual logo images (needs logo URLs).

title.hint: Optional — section can run unannotated under a hero.

items.type: array<{ name: string, logo?: string, href?: string }>
items.hint: 6-12 items. For 'chips' variant, only name is needed. For 'logos' variant, logo URL is required. href optional.

variant.hint: 'chips' for text/integrations (no images). 'logos' for actual logo images.
